name: AirPlay Receiver
description: Turns the kiosk into an AirPlay speaker. Play music and audio from an iPhone, iPad or Mac to Kiosk Satellite, with volume control, track info, cover art and a Now Playing card. Publishes playback state to Home Assistant and lowers AirPlay audio while the voice assistant talks. Audio only: screen mirroring and AirPlay 2 multi-room are not supported. Not affiliated with Apple.
author: Ian White

settings.title: Speaker name
settings.description: The name shown in the AirPlay menu on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Leave empty to use this kiosk's device name.

settings.title: Audio buffer
settings.description: How much audio to hold before playing. Raise it if playback stutters on a weak Wi-Fi connection.

settings.title: Lower AirPlay while the assistant talks
settings.description: Turn AirPlay audio down while Voice Satellite listens and answers.

settings.title: Wake the screen when playback starts
settings.description: Dismiss the screensaver and turn the display on when AirPlay audio starts.

settings.title: Now Playing card
settings.description: Show the track, artist and cover art over the dashboard: for a few seconds when the track changes, or for as long as audio plays.

settings.title: Port
settings.description: TCP port for AirPlay connections, 1024 to 65535. Change it only if another app already uses 7000.

settings.title: AirPlay device ID
settings.description: Generated on first start. Clear it to make Apple devices see this kiosk as a new speaker.

settings.title: Legacy pairing
settings.description: Ask senders to pair before streaming. Off connects faster. Turn it on only if a sender refuses to connect.

settings.title: Feature flags
settings.description: For troubleshooting only. Leave empty for the audio-only default (0x527FDE00). See the README.
